_help: Tunable numbers for the whole game. Edit and relaunch play.bat.
tickRate: simulation steps per second (fixed; rendering is smoothed between steps).
player.speedTilesPerSec: base walking speed at the 1.0x setting.
player.colliderRadiusPx: how fat the unit is for wall collision, in pixels.
camera.followLerp: 0..1, how quickly the camera catches up to the player each frame.
tasks.durationSec: seconds a task takes, per type. tasks.botJitter: bots vary their time by this fraction.
bots.wanderIdleSec: [min, max] seconds a bot loiters after wandering somewhere.
bots.feel: what makes bots walk like people, not robots. All times in seconds, ranges are [min, max].
vision.zoomAtOneX: camera zoom when the view-distance setting is 1.0x. Higher view distance = more zoomed out.
vision.lobbyZoom: fixed camera zoom in the lobby (view distance does not apply there).
stars.layers: the star background. speed is pixels per second downward; bigger scale = closer stars.
rules: fixed distances and timers from SPEC 13. Ranges in tiles, times in seconds.
bots.report.delaySec: how long a crew bot takes to report a body it has reached. bots.kill.hesitateSec: pause before an impostor bot kills.
meeting: resultSec is how long the ejection result stays up. botChat paces bot messages (SPEC 9.9). botVote.skipChance is how often a Phase 2 bot skips.
